result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

The choice comes down to whether you prioritise ease of use or value for money. Both offer proper business accounts, shared vaults and administrator controls.

## My top 5 recommendations

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong administrator controls and reporting.

Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundations.
- Shared collections and password vaults.
- User management and audit logs.
- Good security features for the price.

Approximately \$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Excellent administrative controls.
- Shared folders and team permissions.
- Strong compliance capabilities.
- Good for businesses with stricter security requirements.

Business plans from approximately \$4/user/month.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing and aliases.
- Worth considering if privacy is a major priority.

Business plans from approximately \$1.99/user/month.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Dashlane**

- Straightforward user experience.
- Password health monitoring.
- Security alerts and phishing protection.
- Good reporting and administration.

Business pricing varies by package.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are indicative USD figures from November 2026, generally billed annually, before tax. Check current UK pricing and VAT before purchasing. ## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes |
| Team permissions | Excellent | Very good |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Value for money | Good | Excellent |
| Open source | No | Yes |


## What I'd look for in a small business

Regardless of which one you choose, I'd consider these essential\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Share company logins without sending passwords over email or Slack.
- **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login.
- **Two-factor authentication\:** Protect access to the vault.
- **Access management\:** Remove access immediately when someone leaves.
- **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed credentials.
- **Recovery\:** Have a secure way to recover accounts if an employee loses access.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right one rather than simply the most popular.

**1\. How many people are in your team?**

2–5 people

5–10 people

10–25 people

25–50 people

50+ people

---

**2\. What's your approximate budget per person per month?**

Under £3

£3–£6

£6–£10

Budget is flexible

---

**3\. What's most important?**

Easy to use, with strong security

Maximum security and administration

Lowest possible cost

Privacy and data control

---

**Which business environment do you use?**

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

Both

Neither / other
